create_vec_frame_stack_wrapper: create a VecFrameStack wrapper that stacks n frames along the last axis of a VecEnv observation space
step_wait_frame_stack: step_wait on a VecFrameStack wrapper to roll observations and return stacked frames with rewards and dones
reset_frame_stack: reset a VecFrameStack wrapper to clear stacked observations and initialize with the first observation
reset_agent_frame_stack: reset_agent on a VecFrameStack wrapper to clear stacked observations and set the latest agent observation
reset_random_frame_stack: reset_random on a VecFrameStack wrapper to clear stacked observations and set a random initial observation
